_about: Organizational corrective-action memory (CAPAs / 8D / lessons learned) that UC5 draws on to propose containment, prevention and detection actions for high-risk PFMEA rows. SEED/EXAMPLE entries — replace with your real CAPA/8D history. The 'keywords' drive automatic matching to failure modes; 'source' is the record reference.

lessons.title: Bus-bar weld escapes (insufficient penetration)
lessons.containment: Quarantine suspect weld lots; add a temporary 100% post-weld resistance check and sample destructive pull-test until the schedule is re-validated.
lessons.prevention: Lock the weld schedule (power/energy/time) under change control; degrease/clean mating surfaces; control cell-to-busbar gap with the fixture.
lessons.detection: Closed-loop in-process weld energy/force-vs-displacement monitoring with auto-reject; periodic destructive pull/peel testing.

lessons.title: Weld burn-through / case breach
lessons.containment: Quarantine and 100% visual + leak/insulation check of affected units.
lessons.prevention: Cap upper power limit in the weld program; verify laser focus/standoff at setup; first-article approval each shift.
lessons.detection: Post-weld vision inspection for burn-through and spatter; thermal/plume monitoring.

lessons.title: Cell/PCB damage during manual handling and ESD
lessons.containment: Segregate and inspect units from the affected station; audit ESD controls.
lessons.prevention: Soft/keyed handling fixtures; ESD wrist straps and mats; operator handling certification.
lessons.detection: Post-operation visual/dimensional check; continuous ESD event monitoring at the bench.

lessons.title: Wrong part / material mix-up at point of use
lessons.containment: Segregate suspect builds; verify lot genealogy against the build record.
lessons.prevention: Kitting with single-piece flow; physically separate look-alike parts; scan-to-confirm part number before use.
lessons.detection: Barcode/vision part verification interlock that blocks the operation on mismatch.

lessons.title: Reversed / wrong-orientation component
lessons.containment: 100% orientation/polarity check on suspect units before the next operation.
lessons.prevention: Poka-yoke keyed fixture that physically prevents seating in the wrong orientation.
lessons.detection: Vision or electrical polarity check immediately after the operation.

lessons.title: Test escape / false accept (gauge capability)
lessons.containment: Re-test retained and shipped suspect lots; temporarily tighten accept limits.
lessons.prevention: Run a gauge R&R study; set accept limits from demonstrated capability; scheduled probe maintenance.
lessons.detection: Periodic calibration plus 'test-the-tester' with known-good and known-bad masters each shift.

lessons.title: Inspection/test step bypassed or not run
lessons.containment: Audit traceability to find untested units; hold and test them.
lessons.prevention: Hard interlock — the next operation is blocked without a pass record; serial-scan gate at the station.
lessons.detection: MES-enforced routing with a bypass alarm and supervisor escalation.

lessons.title: Wrong / missing / unreadable label (traceability loss)
lessons.containment: Hold affected product and re-verify labels against the build record.
lessons.prevention: Print-on-demand labels from the build record; scan-verify the label before pack-out.
lessons.detection: Vision check for label presence/readability plus checksum/serial scan verification.

lessons.title: Contamination / foreign object (FOD)
lessons.containment: Clean the line and inspect product made since the last clean point.
lessons.prevention: Cleanliness controls, covers/enclosures, and FOD discipline at the station.
lessons.detection: Vision/cleanliness verification; particle or contamination checks on a sample basis.

lessons.title: Under/over torque, loose or cross-threaded fasteners
lessons.prevention: Torque-controlled tools with error-proofed sequence; fastener presence/seating check.
lessons.detection: Torque-monitoring tool with per-joint data logging and periodic audit.

lessons.title: Missing component / under-count
lessons.prevention: Full-nest presence sensors before the next operation; scan-count at pack-out.
lessons.detection: Presence/vision count check that blocks progression on a short count.

lessons.title: Moisture-driven screen plugging / throughput loss
lessons.containment: Divert high-moisture material; manually reduce feed rate to avoid shutdown.
lessons.prevention: Upstream drying control; queue/blend material by moisture to a stable mean.
lessons.detection: In-line moisture sensors driving automatic feed-rate adjustment.

lessons.title: Equipment wear from ash / inorganics / abrasives
lessons.containment: Increase inspection and replacement frequency for wear parts.
lessons.prevention: Remove inorganics upstream (screening / air classification); specify harder wear materials.
lessons.detection: Motor-current and vibration trend monitoring; scheduled wear measurement.
